title: 第38章 这个班没我，迟早得散
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 陆阳这个老乡回来了。但却成了个哑巴。像是身体回来，魂却不见了。而他“偷”东西的这件事，也很快在全连传播开来。但和以往不同，这次绝大多数人都是对他报以同情和理解态度。有人说，如果一个为了钱犯罪，那么这个人有罪；但如果一个人为了面包犯罪，那么这社会有罪。那如果，一个如过街老鼠般的家伙，去为了一群人而去抢面包，那他到底是好还是坏？对于这件事，每个人心里都有自已的一杆秤，也都有各自的理解。但总的而言，三班新兵在得知这家伙是为了他们才犯错误后，内心挺复杂的。尤其是经常吃了饿，还调侃过他惦记他蛋白粉的孔垄，更是莫名的有种想扇自已一嘴巴的感觉。东北人的直性子，让孔垄养成了对事不对人的态度。所以，他觉得这事没毛病，甚至觉得炊事班那帮老兵简直是故意找茬，小题大做。此外，三班新兵还觉得在这件事情最终解决和处理上，班长实在有失偏颇。......第二天上午的训练一切如常，好似什么都没发生过。但每个人都有种毛衣穿反，又刺挠又勒脖子的难受感觉。陆阳的这位老乡自打昨晚回来就变得不怎么说话，除了报数，报告，是，之类简短的话语，嘴里再也掏不出别的东西。像是物理意义上的将自已给封闭起来，不接受外界信息。“解散，休息十分钟。”组间休息，班长周凯东一如既往的去大厕所抽烟。但临走前却给了陆阳一个意味深长的目光。他知道，这是又来活儿了。事实上，昨天这件事过后，指导员就找到周凯东谈话，并当着丁腾飞的面把他批评了一顿。周凯东也很惭愧的说了抱歉，然后把人给领回来。但，矛盾的化解却并没有想象中的那么简单。越是自尊心强的人，越是容易被击垮。这位老乡自从入伍那天起，各种挨骂挨批评，好不容易才终于下定决心要变好，也确确实实在为此努力。眼看临门一脚，就在快成功的时候，被怒气上头的周凯东给一巴掌扇的灰飞烟灭。军人也是人，是人就会犯错，即便周凯东是个老兵也不例外。他也会被怒气冲昏头，有自已的主观情绪，被情绪化左右。而现在问题出现了，只能是陆阳这个班副想办法，跟在中间缝缝补补。看看能不能将丁腾飞这支被伤透了心的迷途羔羊，给重新拉回到集体里来。“哎，这个班没我，迟早得散！”陆阳感慨了一下，内心稍微整理了下措辞。可这次，对方却没有给他这个机会，看到陆阳走过来便自觉识趣躲开。没有一句话，没有任何表情，如同磁铁同性相斥，根本不让陆阳靠近。这让始终关注这边动态的周凯东，十分无奈的摇了摇头果然再一再二不再三，同样招数两次已是极限，再往后就不灵了。“哎，你说这一排长也真是，十年老兵了怎么就被情绪影响，犯这么低级的错误？”忽然，一墙之隔后头传来打火机的啪嗒声，接着便是几个老兵班长聚在一块聊天的声音。“谁说不是呢？丁腾飞这个兵虽说桀骜不驯，但我算是瞧出来了，这小子本性不坏。”“我也分析过，他那不是坏，纯粹就是没长脑子。以前没人教在外头野惯了，现在忽然收紧绳子，那不得挣扎两下吗？”“要我说，这小子毕竟跟陆阳是老乡，近朱者赤近墨者黑，只要他俩走得近，丁腾飞后头想学坏都难。”“其实这两天那小子开始有变好的迹象，都试着融入集体了，训练上也挺认。”“好家伙一巴掌给周凯东又扇回原型，现在像个哑巴一样。”“这么严重，不至于吧？”“你要是靠着努力，从班里倒数考到前几，满心欢喜的回家，以为会受到表扬。结果家人给你把试卷撕了，骂你是抄的，还说你不配当他们儿子，你会是什么心情？”“还真别说，我小时候真经历过，不过.....我那确实是抄的。不过，真碰上这种情况，心里肯定压抑难受，自暴自弃。”“其实，这样的兵要是放到我们班好好调教调教，引到正路上来，说不准将来真有机会成尖子。可惜啊，可惜！”部队里，有不少尖子兵刚进部队时，都是不服管教的刺头。区别于绝大多数人三棍子打不出一个屁的性格，这类人往往更加要强，自尊心也更强，凡事都不想输给别人。正因如此，才会在训练里更加努力，也更容易取得一些好成绩。但这里头也涉及到概率问题，往往那些没能学好的刺头，义务兵结束就被一脚踢出部队了，压根轮不着他们表现。只有那些改过自新积极表现，并且有一技之长的“刺头”才能继续走的根源，才能被更多的人关注到。以往，丁腾飞留给大家的全都是坏印象，是不好的一面，但在经过这次后大家发现这小子身上也有优点。敢于为集体去犯错误，敢于去为全班偷吃的，敢在被抓包后死不承认的，本身就带着一股子倔劲儿。只可惜，刚燃起了那么点小火苗，就被周凯东的大脚踩灭了。正当大家为此唏嘘时，周凯东面无表情的从外头走进来。先前还在闲聊扯淡的众人立即收声，露出尴尬的表情。“一排长，撒尿啊？”“那什么，你尿着，我先走了。”“我们班休息时间也到了，得赶紧操练起来。”“老八，你先前不是说，抽完烟想拉个屎吗？”“憋回去了，不想拉了！”几个老兵估摸着，先前那番话很可能已经被听着了。这种背后议论，被当事人逮个正着的场面实在尴尬极了。大厕所里的气味依旧难闻，上完厕所的周凯东拧开水龙头洗了把手。看着面前灰蒙蒙的破镜子，以及上头被碎裂纹路分割成一块块的脸。周凯东脑袋里再次出现，昨天情绪失控时撂下的那些狠话，抬手狠狠的给了自已一巴掌！火辣辣的痛感从脸上传来，脸颊的疼痛让他更加自责懊悔。入伍这么多年，他一直严于律已以身作则，尽心尽责的为部队奉献，培养优秀士兵。一直以来他觉得自已一直都是公正严明，赏罚分明的好班长；却没想到，也有戴着有色眼镜看人的那一天。仅仅只是看到的一个片段，就武断的把丁腾飞定性成小偷，尽管他试着去维护和相信，却并没能相信到底。这对一个心智尚未成熟，努力想要变好的新兵而言，造成的创伤实在太大。“班长...”陆阳的声音，在身后响起。他先前瞧见周凯东在厕所门口驻足许久，状态似乎有些不对劲，于是就跟了上来。果不其然，看到镜子前一脸懊悔沮丧，无比自责的周凯东。周凯东回过头，挤出无奈的笑容：“陆阳，你说实话，班长是不是很差劲？”陆阳摇头：“没有。”周凯东：“没有吗？可我从第一面见到你，就各种阴阳怪气，你难道不觉得我是个很不好相处的人，分到我班上的时候就没有过一点儿抵触？”陆阳沉默了，因为最开始他对周凯东的印象也不太好。这家伙不仅很凶，而且擅长阴阳怪气，还给自已起了“读书人”这样的外号。周凯东笑了，他挺喜欢陆阳的坦诚和不做作：“我觉得，我可能不太适合当你们班长......”陆阳心头一震，看着镜子里周凯东那张落寞的脸，顿感大事不妙。那边问题还没解决，班长这边也出了状况。真让人一个头，两个大......
content_en: Lu Yang, a fellow countryman, is back.But he became mute.It's like the body is back, but the soul is gone.And the incident of him "stealing" things quickly spread throughout the company.But unlike in the past, this time most people showed sympathy and understanding towards him.Some people say that if a person commits a crime for money, then the person is guilty; but if a person commits a crime for bread, then the society is guilty.So if a guy like a street rat goes to grab bread for a group of people, is he a good person or a bad person?Regarding this matter, everyone has his or her own mind and understanding.But in general, the recruits in the third class felt quite complicated after learning that this guy made a mistake for them.Especially Kong Long, who was often hungry and had teased him about missing his protein powder, felt inexplicably like slapping himself in the mouth.The straightforward nature of Northeastern people made Kong Long develop an attitude of not caring about people.Therefore, he felt that there was nothing wrong with this matter, and he even felt that the veterans in the cooking class were just deliberately looking for trouble and making a fuss out of a molehill.In addition, the third class recruits also felt that the squad leader was really biased in the final resolution and handling of this matter....The next morning's training went as usual, as if nothing had happened.But everyone has the uncomfortable feeling of wearing a sweater inside out, scratching and strangling the neck.Lu Yang's fellow villager has become very quiet since he came back last night. Apart from short words such as counting, reporting, yes, etc., he can't take anything else out of his mouth.It's like sealing yourself off in a physical sense and not accepting information from the outside world."Dismissed, take a ten-minute break." During the break between groups, squad leader Zhou Kaidong went to the big toilet to smoke as usual.But before leaving, he gave Lu Yang a meaningful look.He knew that this was another job.In fact, after yesterday's incident, the instructor talked to Zhou Kaidong and criticized him in front of Ding Tengfei.Zhou Kaidong also said sorry in shame, and then took the person back.However, resolving conflicts is not as simple as imagined.The more self-esteem a person has, the easier it is to be defeated.Since the day he joined the army, this fellow had been scolded and criticized in various ways. It was not easy for him to finally make up his mind to change for the better, and he was indeed working hard to do so.Just when he was about to succeed, he was slapped to death by an angry Zhou Kaidong.Soldiers are also human beings, and they make mistakes, even if Zhou Kaidong is a veteran.He will also be carried away by anger, have his own subjective emotions, and be swayed by emotions.But now that a problem has arisen, Lu Yang, the squad deputy, can only find a way and patch things up in the middle.Let's see if we can bring Ding Tengfei, a lost lamb who was heartbroken, back into the group."Hey, without me, this class will have to disperse sooner or later!" Lu Yang sighed and sorted out his words in his mind.But this time, the other party didn't give him this chance. When he saw Lu Yang approaching, he consciously avoided it.There was no word, no expression, just like magnets that repel each other, not letting Lu Yang get close at all.This made Zhou Kaidong, who had always been paying attention to the developments here, shake his head helplessly. Sure enough, he repeated the same trick again and again. The same trick twice was the limit, and it would not work after that."Hey, you said this platoon leader is really serious. How could a veteran of ten years be affected by his emotions and make such a low-level mistake?" Suddenly, the click of a lighter came from behind a wall, followed by the sound of several veteran squad leaders gathering together to chat."Who says it's not the case? Although Ding Tengfei is a rebellious soldier, I can tell that this kid is not bad in nature." "I have also analyzed that he is not bad, he just has no brains. He was used to being wild outside without being taught before, and now the rope is suddenly tightened, how about a struggle?" "Let me tell you, after all, this kid is not like Lu Yang.We are fellow villagers.As long as they are close to each other, it will be difficult for Ding Tengfei to learn bad things.""In fact, the boy has started to show signs of getting better in the past two days, and he has tried to integrate into the group, and he has been recognized in training."Right?""If you work hard and get to the top of the class, you will go home happily, thinking that you will be praised. But your family will tear up the test paper for you and accuse you of copying, and say that you are not worthy of being their son. How would you feel?""However, if this happens, I will definitely feel depressed and give up.""Actually, if such soldiers are trained and trained on the right path, they may have a chance to become top leaders in the future. What a pity, what a pity!"There are many top soldiers in the army who are disobedient to discipline.Different from the overwhelming majority of people who can't beat anyone with three sticks, this kind of people tend to be stronger, have stronger self-esteem, and don't want to lose to others in anything.Because of this, I will work harder in training and it will be easier to achieve some good results.But this also involves the issue of probability. Often those who fail to learn how to be a good thorn are kicked out of the army at the end of their compulsory service, and they have no chance to perform at all.Only those "thornheads" who have reformed their mistakes and are active and have skills can continue to go to the root cause and be noticed by more people.In the past, Ding Tengfei left everyone with a bad impression and a bad side, but after this experience, everyone discovered that this kid also has advantages.Those who dare to make mistakes for the sake of the group, those who dare to steal food for the whole class, those who dare to refuse to admit it after being caught, have a certain stubbornness in themselves.It's a pity that as soon as a small flame ignited, it was stamped out by Zhou Kaidong's big foot.Just as everyone was lamenting this, Zhou Kaidong walked in from the outside with an expressionless face.Everyone who was chatting away immediately stopped talking and showed embarrassed expressions."Queen in a row, are you peeing?" "What, you pee, I'm leaving first." "It's time for our class to have a break, so we have to start practicing quickly." "Old man, didn't you say before that you wanted to poop after smoking?" "I held it back, I don't want to poop anymore!" Several veterans estimated that those previous words had probably been listened to.This kind of discussion behind the scenes and being caught by the person involved is really embarrassing.The smell in the big toilet was still bad. After using the toilet, Zhou Kaidong turned on the faucet and washed the handles.He looked at the gray and broken mirror in front of him and the face that was divided into pieces by cracked lines.Zhou Kaidong's mind reappeared, and those cruel words he said when he lost control of his emotions yesterday, raised his hand and slapped himself hard!A burning pain came from his face, and the pain in his cheek made him blame himself and regret even more.After joining the army for so many years, he has always been strict in discipline and set an example, dedicated himself to the army and cultivated outstanding soldiers.He had always felt that he had always been a good squad leader who was fair and strict, with clear rewards and punishments; but he never thought that there would be a day when he would look at people through colored glasses.Just seeing a fragment, he arbitrarily characterized Ding Tengfei as a thief. Although he tried to defend and believe it, he could not believe it to the end.This is too traumatic for a recruit who is not yet mentally mature and is trying hard to become a good person."Squad leader..." Lu Yang's voice sounded behind him.He had seen Zhou Kaidong standing at the door of the toilet for a long time. Something seemed wrong, so he followed him.Sure enough, I saw Zhou Kaidong in front of the mirror with a regretful, frustrated face and extremely self-blame.Zhou Kaidong turned around and forced out a helpless smile: "Lu Yang, tell the truth, isn't the class monitor a bad person?" Lu Yang shook his head: "No." Zhou Kaidong: "No? But from the first time I met you, you were all kinds of weird. Don't you think I'm a very difficult person to get along with, and you didn't have any conflicts when you were assigned to my class?" Lu Yang was silent, because he didn't have a good impression of Zhou Kaidong at first.This guy is not only very fierce, but also good at yin and yang, and has even given himself the nickname "Scholar".Zhou Kaidong smiled. He liked Lu Yang's frankness and lack of pretentiousness: "I think I might not be suitable to be your squad leader..." Lu Yang's heart was shocked.
